title: P23: endpoint paths use the §5.1 /v1 prefix
description: protocol-06 §5.2ff write endpoints as e.g. 'POST /keyMaterial/{targetUser}' with no prefix; the §5.1 directory example uses '/v1/keyMaterial/{targetUser}'. Readings: (a) no prefix; (b) /v1 per example. Chosen: (b). Rationale: clients discover endpoints via the directory, so either interoperates; following the concrete example is the least surprising. WG question filed.
